# Agent Python Tools

- repo_uri: https://github.com/google-deepmind/gemini-robotics-sdk

## File: google-deepmind_gemini-robotics-sdk/examples/model/gemini_robotics_aloha_eval_example.py

Prompts

```
['run the Gemini Robotics policy evaluation loop on an Aloha dual-arm robot with camera and joint observations', 'build a TimeStepSpec defining image, joint position, and instruction observation specs for the Aloha robot', 'create an ImageController that subscribes to ROS compressed image topics and stores the latest frames per camera', 'create a KeyDetect context manager that listens for non-blocking key presses in a background thread', 'create a SigintHandler that registers a custom SIGINT signal handler and restores the previous handler on cleanup']
```

Usage

```
{'run_gemini_robotics_policy_eval': 'run the Gemini Robotics policy evaluation loop on an Aloha dual-arm robot with camera and joint observations', 'build_timestep_spec': 'build a TimeStepSpec defining image, joint position, and instruction observation specs for the Aloha robot', 'create_image_controller': 'create an ImageController that subscribes to ROS compressed image topics and stores the latest frames per camera', 'create_key_detect': 'create a KeyDetect context manager that listens for non-blocking key presses in a background thread', 'create_sigint_handler': 'create a SigintHandler that registers a custom SIGINT signal handler and restores the previous handler on cleanup'}
```
